Hi Elena / Marco,

Following up on invoice INV-2026-09-78 (net EUR 142,800) — our records show this is 36 days past due. We haven’t received payment or a payment plan. Marco, you mentioned VAT questions on our last call; if there’s outstanding tax documentation needed from our side, let me know exactly what you need and I’ll get it over today.

If we don’t hear back by EOD Fri 2026-09-17 we’ll have to move the account into the next dunning stage and notify finance/leadership for possible credit hold. I’d prefer to avoid that and work with you on a short-term payment pathway (partial + remainder) while the VAT thing is resolved.

Attachments: INV-2026-09-78.pdf (invoice, 132KB)

- You confirm required VAT evidence (e.g., certificate of business status or reverse charge form) by Wed 9/15.
- If needed, Brightline makes a 40% partial payment by Mon 9/20 and we schedule the remainder by 10/15.

Thanks — I can hop on a quick call if that’s easier.

Best,

They’ve asked for a company VAT certificate and the contract page that shows pricing terms (we’ll attach our letter from Piemonte Accounting once we have that).

2) Cashflow: we can commit to a 40% payment by 2026-09-20 and the balance by 2026-10-15, but that is contingent on the tax papers being available to our AP.

I’m copying Piemonte Accounting (ap@piemonteaudit.it) so they can request whatever they need from you. Can you confirm the documents and whether Redwood can accept a staged payment without interest?

Laura / team — short answers:

1) Documents: we can provide a copy of Redwood’s EU VAT registration certificate and a redacted statement showing invoice line items. That should satisfy an EU AP team for reverse-charge verification in most cases. I’ll attach both to this thread (see Brightline-VAT-certificate.pdf).

2) Risk and staged payment: accepting a partial payment does not materially change our legal exposure if we retain the invoice until paid in full, provided we record the staged payment in our AR system and update terms. No legal blocker to accepting 40% now as long as Brightline signs a simple payment agreement / acknowledgement.

3) Recommendation: request a signed, single-page payment plan (DocuSign). Marcus — can Revenue Ops sign off on an exception to standard dunning for this case if they follow the dates?

I’ll prepare the VAT cert now.

—Olga
